summary_1line: Arjuna reveals the disguised Pandavas to King Virata, praising Yudhishthira and identifying each brother and Draupadi after their incognito year.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna, smiling in Virata’s court, gestures toward the disguised men as he proclaims the virtues of King Yudhishthira.
Arjuna points to the palace cook Vallava, revealing him as the mighty Bhima before the astonished King Virata.
Prince Uttara stands in the royal hall identifying the radiant Pandavas and Draupadi as the court looks on in awe.
